title: Databases (cloud)
description: The four Cloud SQL instances: up, and disk used. "database stopped": stopped on purpose between test sessions (beta's database_activation_policy NEVER; the service's TPA_STOPPED_DATABASES). "not reporting": no value, and not listed as stopped: not built (cc-db exists with the staffed desk only), or reporting nothing.

links.title: PagerDuty incidents
links.tooltip: Open incidents page through PagerDuty; this site cannot list them

panels.title: auth-db (auth and its jobs; app project)
Up
panels.description: Cloud SQL's `database/up` for auth-db, the lowest in each interval. `auth-db-down` (urgent) pages below 1 for five minutes. "database stopped": stopped on purpose between test sessions (beta's database_activation_policy NEVER; the service's TPA_STOPPED_DATABASES). "not reporting": no value, and not listed as stopped: not built (cc-db exists with the staffed desk only), or reporting nothing.

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: `auth-db-disk` opens above 85% for ten minutes; automatic growth stops at the instance's disk_autoresize_limit.

panels.title: Now
panels.description: Cloud SQL's own signals for auth-db: `database/up` (the urgent `auth-db-down` pages below 1 for five minutes) and disk used (`auth-db-disk` at 85% for ten minutes). "database stopped": stopped on purpose between test sessions (beta's database_activation_policy NEVER; the service's TPA_STOPPED_DATABASES). "not reporting": no value, and not listed as stopped: not built (cc-db exists with the staffed desk only), or reporting nothing.
